projects.title: Golf maze 3D
projects.description: A maze/puzzle game built in unity. The player has to navigate through the maze solving puzzles and using skills to get through the obstacles. Each level tells a story through the zone design. The player will go through a normal mini golf scene to underwater to in outer space.

projects.title: SKYBOUND
projects.description: A pirate/steampunk video game set in floating isles. A looter shooter with melee and ship combat elements
